title: Symbolic Workflow Datatype Manifest
description: Physical, syntactic, collection, aggregate, and semantic datatypes passed between workflow tasks. Semantic types may have several interchangeable representations.

types.label: Any value
types.description: Root of the workflow datatype graph.

types.label: Scalar
types.description: Atomic JSON-compatible value.

types.label: Text
types.description: Unicode text.

types.label: Boolean
types.description: True or false.

types.label: Integer
types.description: Whole-number value.

types.label: JSON object
types.description: Structured JSON mapping.

types.label: File path
types.description: Path to one file.

types.label: Directory path
types.description: Path to a directory.

types.label: URL
types.description: Remote resource locator.

types.label: Image
types.description: Raster image value independent of storage.

types.label: Image file
types.description: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image stored on disk.

types.label: Image region
types.description: Bounding box, mask, or crop representing part of an image.

types.label: Image collection
types.description: Ordered set of image files.

types.label: Image sequence
types.description: Temporally ordered image frames.

types.label: Image manifest
types.description: JSON document describing image files, order, provenance, roles, and hashes.

types.label: Video file
types.description: Video source that can be sampled into image frames.

types.label: ARC3 state
types.description: Current debugger state, image, metadata, and optional parent state.

types.label: Source request
types.description: Parameters describing where workflow input should be obtained.

types.label: Prolog source
types.description: SWI-Prolog source text.

types.label: Prolog file
types.description: Prolog source stored as a file.

types.label: Prolog fact set
types.description: Facts describing a state, object, transition, or rule evidence.

types.label: Object properties
types.description: Properties such as color, bbox, shape, role, topology, and relations.

types.label: Turtle program
types.description: Movement-based drawing program using set_pos, fwd, rot, pen state, color, and width.

types.label: Turtle program file
types.description: Turtle program stored in a Prolog file.

types.label: Individual object
types.description: One semantic object regardless of representation.

types.label: Object collection
types.description: Set of semantic objects in one scene.

types.label: Object manifest
types.description: Cross-reference between object identities and their image, Turtle, and Prolog representations.

types.label: Scene
types.description: One interpreted visual state.

types.label: Scene pair
types.description: Before/current or source/target scene pair.

types.label: Transition evidence
types.description: Observed changes and correspondences between scenes.

types.label: Rule set
types.description: Observed and hypothetical transition rules with evidence.

types.label: Render manifest
types.description: Maps Turtle/object inputs to rendered image outputs.

types.label: Display session
types.description: Record of images presented to a human or visual debugger.

types.label: Artifact bundle
types.description: Complete generated evidence for one workflow node.

types.label: Validation report
types.description: Machine-readable consistency and completeness checks.

types.label: Audit report
types.description: Human-readable review of the artifact bundle.

types.label: Workflow report
types.description: Summary of task execution, slots, artifacts, warnings, and provenance.
